subject: National Book Awards 2026
query: when are the national book awards 2026
title: When were the National Book Awards 2026? Nov. 18: the winners
answer: The 77th National Book Awards were presented on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at Cipriani Wall Street in New York. The winners were Hannah Lillith Assadi's "Paradiso 17" for fiction, Abdelrahman ElGendy's "Huna" for nonfiction, Brenda Hillman for poetry, "Centroeuropa" for translated literature and "The Fight of Our Lives" for young people's literature.
body:
Awards are given in five categories: Fiction, Nonfiction, Poetry, Translated Literature and Young People's Literature. Each winner receives $10,000 and a bronze sculpture, and each finalist receives $1,000. Actor Kyle MacLachlan was announced as host and Michelle Zauner as musical guest.

The full list of winners: Fiction, "Paradiso 17" by Hannah Lillith Assadi. Nonfiction, "Huna: A Memoir of Revolution, Prison, and Becoming" by Abdelrahman ElGendy. Poetry, "Still House in the Desert" by Brenda Hillman. Translated Literature, "Centroeuropa" by Vicente Luis Mora, translated from the Spanish by Rahul Bery. Young People's Literature, "The Fight of Our Lives: AIDS in America" by David Levithan and Gabriel Duckels.

Assadi's novel beat fiction finalists Edwidge Danticat's "Dèy," Julián Delgado Lopera's "Pretend You're Dead and I Carry You," Valeria Luiselli's "Beginning Middle End" and Morgan Thomas's "Mad Eden." Salman Rushdie received the foundation's Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters, and pediatrician Perri Klass, a co-founder of the literacy nonprofit Reach Out and Read, received the Literarian Award.
